root_cause: The content-loop released its original single-writer lease using jsonb_build_object('run_date',$3) without casting $3. PostgreSQL cannot infer this parameter's type and the release failed repeatedly, leaving stale leases until expiration.
prevention_rule: Explicitly type all SQL placeholders inside jsonb_build_object at lease release. Preserve the original tenant and exact lease-holder guard; never claim publication success from an unlocked lease.

evidence.log_message: CONTENT_LOOP_LEASE_RELEASE_FAILED could not determine data type of parameter $3
